evals.prompt: Create a feature component named AudioTrackCard under the audio-player feature. This component should display a track's title, artist, duration, and status (e.g., loading, playing, paused, error). It should follow bulletproof-react structure, separating the UI component from local/hook state if needed. Ensure it has its Storybook story with states for playing, paused, and loading, located right next to the component.
evals.expected_output: The component AudioTrackCard.tsx and its Storybook story AudioTrackCard.stories.tsx are created successfully under src/features/audio-player/components/ following the co-location and bulletproof-react principles.

assertions.name: colocated_story
assertions.description: Storybook file is co-located right next to the component

assertions.name: decoupled_logic
assertions.description: Component has minimal logic (business logic, states decoupled or clean props interface)

assertions.name: multiple_states_story
assertions.description: Story defines multiple states (e.g. playing, paused, loading)

evals.prompt: Create a shared UI component named VolumeSlider under src/components/ui/ with a corresponding Storybook story next to it. It should be strictly stateless, taking standard props like value, onChange, and disabled. Implement a nice visual layout using Tailwind CSS.
evals.expected_output: The component VolumeSlider.tsx and its Storybook story VolumeSlider.stories.tsx are created successfully under src/components/ui/ as stateless/style-only files.

assertions.name: colocated_story_ui
assertions.description: Storybook file is co-located right next to the component

assertions.name: stateless_ui
assertions.description: Component is strictly stateless and style-only (no state/hooks imports)
